info.title: RoleControl IAM API
info.description: Cookie-authenticated RoleControl IAM backend with users, roles, permissions, role assignments, and posts.

refreshCookieAuth.description: Signed refresh JWT cookie used by the refresh endpoint.

200.description: Logout completed. The operation is idempotent.

get.summary: Get the current authenticated user and UI capabilities
